notes: Which person (data/players.json id) each of this season's roster rows is, for this sport: a MaxPreps row by its athleteId, a school's own varsity or JV list by its name (athleteId null). Written by pnpm build-players from the registry; never edited by hand.

What is known about a person (recruiting pages, club ties, a college commitment) is filed under her id; a page finds it for a row through this file. A roster refresh or a new season rewrites the rows, and nothing filed under a person moves.
